 GIMS Noida Staff Nurse Online Form 2026 : Eligibility Criteria 
  • For Degree Holder : B.Sc Nursing (4-Year) or B.Sc Nursing (Post Basic) (2-Year) from an INC/State Council-recognized University/Institute + Registered as a Nurse & Midwife with the State/Indian Nursing Council.
  • For Diploma Holder : Diploma in General Nursing Midwifery (GNM) from an INC-recognized Board/Council + Registered as Nurse & Midwife with the State/Indian Nursing Council + 2 years’ experience in a minimum 50-bedded hospital after completing the diploma.
  • For More Details Read Official Notification.
